w: Corrected at B4a-07: the first ruling counted T3-029 as held by all three placements; reader B placed only T3-073 and listed T3-029 under its also_present. Reading A placed T3-009, T3-029 and T3-073, reader B T3-073 with a bag, my B1 T3-029, T3-072 and T3-073. Reader B listed T3-009, T3-029, T3-043 and T3-072 under its also_present. 'Good work over the past few days everyone.', the final result and 'Mindcrack is definitely visible from afar!' mark the work achieved (T3-009, reading A), three concepts. The pride in pulling together 'to make allies and help friends', the failed effort to save the pinkbird 'allies' from r/indonesia's scripts and the creeper's room thanking 'mindcrack and Dutch ... for trying to save him' tell the alliance (T3-072, my B1), three. The two tie at the top on concepts and placements, so both stand. The second work 'completely intact' and the member who woke 'to find him gone' tell the loss plainly (T3-073, all three placements), two; by the T3-029|T3-073 paragraph the plain report counts toward T3-073. 'RIP Doc's face' and the toast to Pakratt and Zisteau grieve (T3-029, reading A and my B1), two; T3-073 leads that level on placements and is kept, and T3-029 is not. The hint of pyro claimed (reader B's T3-043, one), r/armok, the potato on a stick and the Slovak maintainer's GG are left out. Four themes do not reach three, so the item is not a bag.

Corrected at B4a-07 under the reading first applied at kanye t28 and msu t11: a theme both readers placed, with concepts of its own, is not dropped by the level rule on a placement count that only my B1 tips. Reading A placed T3-043, T3-009 and T3-157, reader B T3-043 and T3-157, my B1 T3-009, T3-043 and T3-073. 'We did it! Thanks so much to everyone who contributed.', posted twice, and 'That can only be done through dedication' mark the work achieved (T3-009, reading A and my B1), three concepts, and lead; concepts that celebrate before they thank count toward T3-009. 'thank you and it looks repaired' and 'Thanks to everyone who helped me construct the kitties!' thank the helpers (T3-043, all three placements), two. 'It was a really pleasant experience' and 'It was so much fun spending time with you guys in the discord' say what the time together meant (T3-157, both readers), two; T3-043 would lead that level by my B1's placement alone, so both stand. 'Every new sprite we added I had a feeling that we'd crumble ... but in the end it worked out somehow!' (T3-073, my B1), one, falls past the limit of three. The Marle-Magus joke, the recording of the first pixels and the timelapse asked for are left out.
